FO2727: Forté Occasional Table with Molded Base
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-fo2727-forte-occasional-table-laminate-top-molded-base-n700161
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-occasional-table/
Spec sheets: FO2727 Forté Occasional Table, Molded Base, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Occasional Table with Laminate Top and Molded Base – FO2727
Current H1: Norix Forté Durable Occasional Table with Laminate Top and Molded Base - FO2727
Subtitle: 27” Square Laminate-Top Lounge Table on a Ballastable Molded Base That Gangs with Forté Lounge Chairs
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FO2727 Occasional Table with Laminated Top and Molded Base
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Occasional Table with Molded Base is a 27” square, 13.2” high laminate-top table on a rotationally molded base, for lounges and waiting areas in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. It can stand alone or be ganged with Forté lounge chairs as an intermediate or corner table.
The high-pressure laminate top has a radiused polyurethane edge that is pressure fused to the top, so it stays sanitary and pick resistant, and embedded T-nuts with Torx head security hardware secure it to the base. The anti-ligature base has no internal openings, and a push-in cap seals the ballast port.
Top: Decorative high-pressure laminate bonded to a 45 lb density particle board core with embedded T-nuts
Edge: Radiused polyurethane edge, pressure fused to the top so it is firmly attached and sanitary
Base: Rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and TruColor polymer; anti-ligature design with no internal openings
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Ganging and Ballast: Molded-in steel threaded inserts for optional side-to-side ganging, and a push-in cap that seals the ballast port
Overall Size: 27”W×27”D×13.2”H
Weight: 48 lbs
Laminate Top Colors: Titanium Evolve, Wild Cherry, Kensington Maple, Asian Sun, Montana Walnut, Palisades Oak, Calcutta Marble, or Black Alicante
Base Colors: Sienna, Dove, or Raven
Static Load Testing: Tested to 1,000 lbs
Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletin 133; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261; UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for the top; the molded base can also be cleaned with bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 per the manufacturer’s instructions
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty; to validate it, the table must be bolted down or ballasted with 100 lbs of sand
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FO2727 – Molded Base: 27”×27” laminate top, 48 lbs
Options: Ganging kit (C011-016), bolt-down plate (C011-026), and factory ballasting (50 lbs)
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging and Ballast: Installation required for ganging plates and ballast; Norix recommends 100 lbs of dry sand or gravel to validate the warranty (not supplied by Norix)
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Occasional Table with Molded Base suits lounges and waiting areas where a side table has to be safe and hard to move or throw.
Typical applications include:
Lounges, dayrooms, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies, waiting rooms, and visitation areas
Dayrooms and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Options: the price list shows the ganging kit (C011-016) at $50, the bolt-down plate (C011-026) at $87, and factory ballasting (50 lbs) at $84 (list). They are in the text but are not variants. Would you like any of them as variants?
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (row 209: 48 / 27 / 27 / 13.2).
Images: the 5 current images are kept (Dove, Sienna, and Raven bases and 2 color charts). Image 2 (laminate chart) has the alt text "...with Laminate Top and Wood Base." No new photos to suggest.
